verdict.rationale: Crossmint's Agent Checkouts claims an agent can 'buy from any merchant with a single API' from a product URL, and its headless checkout APIs work outside the browser. A merchant's products could therefore be bought by agents indirectly. But this is a buyer/agent-side tool: nothing shows merchant onboarding or checkout delivered inside ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Copilot. Missing for 10: named chat-surface integrations (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot), a merchant-side listing or catalog for assistant commerce, webhooks for agent checkouts (v1 is poll-only), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
